version.changelog:
Initial release of dataify-duckduckgo-search:

- Enables searching DuckDuckGo via the Dataify API using a bundled Python script.
- Adds a preview step before every API call, displaying parameters in a table and allowing user edits.
- Requires user confirmation before executing any search request.
- Supports explicit and natural-language mapping to API fields, using documented defaults only.
- Handles user authentication with Dataify API tokens, prompting if missing.
- Outputs search results exactly as returned by the script, without modification.

llm.summary: This is a disclosed Dataify DuckDuckGo search skill, but it handles a Dataify API token in a way users should review before installing.

dimensions.detail: The bundled Python script and outbound request to Dataify fit the stated DuckDuckGo search purpose, and the skill requires a preview plus user confirmation before calling the API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions tell the agent to pass a user-provided Dataify API token with a --token command-line argument, which can expose the secret through process listings or shell history even though token use itself is purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no package install or autostart behavior; the skill runs a bundled executable Python script with python3.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access and DATAIFY_API_TOKEN use are disclosed in the body, but they are not declared in structured frontmatter permissions or environment metadata.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background worker, destructive local action, or local file mutation was found; the script only sets the token in its own process environment before making the request.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending search queries to Dataify and using a Dataify API token. Prefer setting DATAIFY_API_TOKEN in a controlled environment or using an interactive secret prompt rather than passing the token as --token in a shell command, and make sure the preview/confirmation step is followed before any search request.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Environment token use and outbound network access are expected for a Dataify-backed search helper, but the missing structured declaration supports review rather than a malicious verdict.
[suspicious.secret_argv_exposure] unexpected: The artifact-backed command example passes a high-value API token on the command line; this is an avoidable credential-handling risk and is the main reason for Review.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal reported no malicious or suspicious engine detections, so it does not add negative evidence.
